email.description: Email address of the account to reset

link.description: Single-use link to the reset page; give it to the user

message.description: Message to show to the person who registered

token.description: The single-use token from the reset link

builtIn.description: Whether the role is defined in SystemRoles (reset on every start-up)

value.description: For orgTimezone, an IANA zone id such as "Europe/Bucharest". For worldClocks, a JSON array of {"label", "tz"} objects encoded as a string

canEdit.description: Whether the caller may edit this user (USER_UPDATE and the manager scope rules)

departmentManagerId.description: The head of the user's department, if it has one

managerOf.description: The department this user is the head of, or null

lastLoginAt.description: Last successful sign-in; null if the user never signed in

managerOf.description: The id of the department this user is the manager (head) of, or null

total.description: Users matching the filters, on all pages

events.description: Event names to deliver; "*" means every event. Defaults to ["*"] when missing or empty

url.description: http(s) address that receives the events, at most 255 characters
